improved-life-tap.name: Improved Life Tap
improved-life-tap.r1: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 10%.
improved-life-tap.rmax: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 20%.

suppression.name: Suppression
suppression.r1: Improves your chance to hit by 1% and reduces all threat you generate by 4%.
suppression.rmax: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.

improved-corruption.name: Improved Corruption
improved-corruption.r1: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 0.4 sec and increases the damage it deals by 2%.
improved-corruption.rmax: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%.

grim-reach.name: Grim Reach
grim-reach.r1: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by 10%.
grim-reach.rmax: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by 20%.

soul-harvest.name: Soul Harvest
soul-harvest.r1: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by 50% for 10 sec and allows 50% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
soul-harvest.rmax: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by 100% for 10 sec and allows 100% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

improved-drains.name: Improved Drains
improved-drains.r1: Increases Health drained, damage done, or Mana drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Drain Mana spells by 7%.
improved-drains.rmax: Increases Health drained, damage done, or Mana drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Drain Mana spells by 20%.

improved-bane-of-agony.name: Improved Bane of Agony
improved-bane-of-agony.r1: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 5%.
improved-bane-of-agony.rmax: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 10%.

fel-concentration.name: Fel Concentration
fel-concentration.r1: Gives your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells a 23% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
fel-concentration.rmax: Gives your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

amplify-curse.name: Amplify Curse
amplify-curse.r1: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.
amplify-curse.rmax: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

pandemic.name: Pandemic
pandemic.r1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 33%.
pandemic.rmax: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%.

malevolence.name: Malevolence
malevolence.r1: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 1%.
malevolence.rmax: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 5%.

nightfall.name: Nightfall
nightfall.r1: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 2% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.
nightfall.rmax: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

curse-of-exhaustion.name: Curse of Exhaustion
curse-of-exhaustion.cost: 8% of base mana · 30 yd range · Instant
curse-of-exhaustion.r1: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
curse-of-exhaustion.rmax: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

siphon-life.name: Siphon Life
siphon-life.r1: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.
siphon-life.rmax: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

soul-siphon.name: Soul Siphon
soul-siphon.r1: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 4% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%.
soul-siphon.rmax: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 12% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 36%.

shadow-mastery.name: Shadow Mastery
shadow-mastery.r1: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 2%.
shadow-mastery.rmax: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 10%.

wrack.name: Wrack
wrack.r1: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 86 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.
wrack.rmax: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 86 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.

improved-health-funnel.name: Improved Health Funnel
improved-health-funnel.r1: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 20%, reduces its health cost by 15%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 50%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.
improved-health-funnel.rmax: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

improved-imp.name: Improved Imp
improved-imp.r1: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 10% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 10%.
improved-imp.rmax: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 30% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 30%.

unholy-power.name: Unholy Power
unholy-power.r1: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 2%.
unholy-power.rmax: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 10%.

demonic-aegis.name: Demonic Aegis
demonic-aegis.r1: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 15%.
demonic-aegis.rmax: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 30%.

improved-voidwalker.name: Improved Voidwalker
improved-voidwalker.r1: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 10%.
improved-voidwalker.rmax: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 30%.

fel-vitality.name: Fel Vitality
fel-vitality.r1: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 5%, and increases your maximum Mana by 5%.
fel-vitality.rmax: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.

demonic-energies.name: Demonic Energies
demonic-energies.r1: You heal your pet for 8% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 50% of the Mana you gain.
demonic-energies.rmax: You heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.

improved-sayaad.name: Improved Sayaad
improved-sayaad.r1: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 10%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 10%.
improved-sayaad.rmax: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 30%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

demonic-sacrifice.name: Demonic Sacrifice
demonic-sacrifice.r1:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hr. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.
demonic-sacrifice.rmax:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hr. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

master-summoner.name: Master Summoner
master-summoner.r1: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 2 sec and the Mana cost by 20%.
master-summoner.rmax: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.

decimation.name: Decimation
decimation.r1: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 45%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 3% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 20% and costs no Soul Shards.
decimation.rmax: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 90%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 6% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 40% and costs no Soul Shards.

fel-domination.name: Fel Domination
fel-domination.r1: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.
fel-domination.rmax: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

demonic-brand.name: Demonic Brand
demonic-brand.r1: Your Searing Pain generates 17% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 2 attacks against the target deal 1 to 1 Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.
demonic-brand.rmax: Your Searing Pain generates 50% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 6 attacks against the target deal 1 to 1 Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.

improved-felhunter.name: Improved Felhunter
improved-felhunter.r1: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 10%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 2 sec.
improved-felhunter.rmax: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 30%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 6 sec.

soul-link.name: Soul Link
soul-link.cost: 20% of base mana · 100 yd range · Instant
soul-link.r1: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.
soul-link.rmax: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

demonic-knowledge.name: Demonic Knowledge
demonic-knowledge.r1: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 33% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.
demonic-knowledge.rmax: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

master-demonologist.name: Master Demonologist
master-demonologist.r1:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 2%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 2%.

Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 2%.

Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 2%.
master-demonologist.rmax:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 10%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%.

Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 10%.

Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 10%.

demonic-pact.name: Demonic Pact
demonic-pact.r1: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.
demonic-pact.rmax: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

destructive-reach.name: Destructive Reach
destructive-reach.r1: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by 10%.
destructive-reach.rmax: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by 20%.

improved-shadow-bolt.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
improved-shadow-bolt.r1: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 4% for 12 sec.
improved-shadow-bolt.rmax: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 20% for 12 sec.

bane.name: Bane
bane.r1: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.1 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 0.4 sec.
bane.rmax: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.r1: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 3%.
cataclysm.rmax: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.r1: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 10% and your Conflagrate spell has a 20% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.
aftermath.rmax: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 50% and your Conflagrate spell has a 100% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

ruin.name: Ruin
ruin.r1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 20%.
ruin.rmax: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%.

shadowburn.name: Shadowburn
shadowburn.cost: 105 Mana · 30 yd range · Instant · 15 sec cooldown
shadowburn.r1: Instantly blasts the target for 65 to 74 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.
shadowburn.rmax: Instantly blasts the target for 65 to 74 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.r1: Gives your Destruction spells a 23% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
intensity.rmax: Gives your Destruction spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

agonizing-flames.name: Agonizing Flames
agonizing-flames.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 3% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 3%.
agonizing-flames.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 10%.

conflagrate.name: Conflagrate
conflagrate.cost: 100 Mana · 30 yd range · Instant · 10 sec cooldown
conflagrate.r1: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 88 to 111 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.
conflagrate.rmax: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 88 to 111 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

pyroclasm.name: Pyroclasm
pyroclasm.r1: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 13% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 13% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.
pyroclasm.rmax: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 26% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 26% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

bane-of-havoc.name: Bane of Havoc
bane-of-havoc.cost: 5% of base mana · 30 yd range · Instant
bane-of-havoc.r1: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.
bane-of-havoc.rmax: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

fire-and-brimstone.name: Fire and Brimstone
fire-and-brimstone.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 8%.
fire-and-brimstone.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 25%.

shadow-and-flame.name: Shadow and Flame
shadow-and-flame.r1: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 4% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 4% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 20% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 20% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.
shadow-and-flame.rmax: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 20% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 20% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 100% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 100% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.r1: Deals 100 to 114 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
incinerate.rmax: Deals 100 to 114 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
